title: The cedar mill, iv
logline: Friday. The stack from the base, straight up. Chloe lies down on the floor to see it. The coat gets everything on it. She doesn't care. The strip cares for her.

panels.composition: The stack from its base, straight up, a brick column into gray sky, swallows.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a tall brick smokestack seen from its base looking straight up into a gray sky with swallows, no words

panels.composition: CHLOE lying flat on the mill floor at the base, looking up. The camel coat on the black floor.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a woman in a camel coat lying flat on her back on a black mill floor looking straight up, no words

panels.composition: WOOD standing over her with the dog. Not lying down. Drawing the coat on the floor.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man standing over a woman lying on a mill floor, drawing her, a small dog beside him

panels.composition: The coat when she stands: black, sawdust, blackberry, a thread. Her face: fine with it. The dog shaking itself. The strip's last daily before the Sunday.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a woman standing in a camel coat now streaked with black and sawdust and blackberry, her face untroubled, a small dog shaking itself, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: 'Somebody has to be.' The coat ruined; she doesn't care.
